description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MetadataParserTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to extract metadata such as headers, header maps, and status codes from HTTP responses.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a single header from the response into the result array, converting it to the appropriate type based on shape definition.

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with an optional prefix from the response into the result array.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Places the HTTP status code of the response into the result array.
